brief:
Photographer Misan Harriman has spoken out against media attacks on Meghan Markle, characterizing the coverage as rooted in racism and misogyny, Zeteo reported. The British social justice activist discussed the press campaign targeting the former royal during an interview with Zeteo UK's Sangita Myska.

Harriman also addressed press culpability in the death of academic Jason Arday and media hostility toward him over his Gaza statements. The discussion touched on broader questions of journalistic responsibility and the impact of sustained media campaigns on public figures.
dek: The British social justice activist also chats with Zeteo UK’s Sangita Myska about press culpability in the death of academic Jason Arday and the campaign against him over his Gaza views.
title: Photographer Harriman condemns media racism and misogyny toward Markle
